amount: preserve original nonnegative integer; explicit zero grants nothing; never split, multiply, convert to character XP or duplicate acceptable-task display
recipient: one owned, unreleased, currently selected fighting pet, captured in the same role transaction as first fresh completion
selection_time: before character EXP/level changes from this completion; freeze role level, pet id, growth version, qualification, amount and policy
source_status: ordinary task recipient, time, qualification and level cap are designed; source amount and native keyed absolute refresh layout are client_verified

eligibility.loyalty_lifetime: not additional task-XP conditions; this rule never changes care or resurrects a pet

leveling.pet_at_award_cap: eligible pet receives original XP but does not level beyond the cap; retain unspent XP
leveling.pet_above_award_cap: no pet XP for this completion; no delevel or transfer to another pet
leveling.gaps_and_conflict: client book36006 wording and 2012 guide conflict; exact comparisons above are explicitly designed, not a recovered original algorithm
leveling.overflow: reject entire caller transaction without truncation or partial award
leveling.special_keys: 1001..1150 remain unmapped; never reinterpret them as ordinary levels

outcomes.zero: terminal zero receipt; no growth or version mutation
outcomes.no_selected_pet: terminal not_awarded receipt, original amount and reason retained; task may complete; acquiring a pet later cannot reclaim it
outcomes.dead_or_under_uselevel_or_too_high: terminal not_awarded receipt; keep exact reason, original amount and frozen recipient; other valid channels continue
outcomes.unknown_existing_growth: pending_explicit_pet_baseline_reconciliation; do not fabricate growth or redirect to another pet
outcomes.legacy_completed_without_recipient: pending_explicit_recipient_reconciliation; never choose the pet selected now for an old reward
outcomes.later_missing_recipient: keep original recipient and pending audit for explicit reconciliation; never silently reroute or repeat other paid channels

persistence.fresh_completion: only active -> completed transition in current owner transaction may create recipient decision; retry reads original frozen decision
persistence.atomicity: task state, frozen recipient decision, role XP, item/currency channels, pet growth and channel/common receipts share caller transaction
persistence.retry: stable task instance + PetExpReward channel + frozen recipient; policy/amount/recipient conflict requires explicit migration
persistence.cyclic_task: not covered by role_id+task_id; implement a unique cycle instance before enabling repeat rewards
persistence.missing_growth: original decision remains frozen; explicit reconciliation may resolve missing baseline only with trusted evidence of original qualification

interfaces.selected_snapshot: Inventory.selected_fighting_pet(db) returns frozen PetState or None in existing caller transaction; no new connection or current-session object
interfaces.capped_award: Inventory.change_pet_growth(db, pet_id, stable_key, expected_version, 'experience_capped', (original_amount, award_cap)); cap belongs in fingerprint
interfaces.display: after commit, re-read original recipient current PetState and return full pet refresh plus SRefreshPetExp keyed absolute XP; never use a historical receipt as current state
